Container.Name: github-backup
Container.Overview:
[b]github-backup[/b] is a CLI tool that backs up every kind of data GitHub keeps on a user or organisation — repositories (mirror / bare / shallow), issues, pull requests, releases, gists, wikis, topics, branches, deploy keys, collaborators, workflows, environments, discussions, projects, packages, and account relationships.
[b]Run modes[/b] (set [code]BACKUP_MODE[/code] in the template): [b]--doctor[/b] — pre-flight check (git, network, TLS, token). Run this once on first install. [b]--all[/b] — back up everything (the normal scheduled mode). [b]--verify[/b] — verify the SHA-256 manifest of an existing backup. [b]--check[/b] — validate config + connectivity without performing a backup. [b]--list-scopes[/b] — print the OAuth scopes needed for the current flags. [b]--tui[/b] — open the interactive terminal UI (use the Console button).
This container is a one-shot tool: it runs to completion and exits. To schedule recurring backups, install the [b]User Scripts[/b] plugin from Community Applications, add a script that runs [code]docker start github-backup[/code], and set a cron entry (e.g. [code]0 2 * * *[/code] for 2 am daily).
[b]Security[/b] — the image runs as a non-root user (UID/GID 1000), uses rustls (no OpenSSL), holds no inbound ports, and signs every git clone via [code]GIT_ASKPASS[/code] so the token never appears in the process list. Backup metadata can additionally be AES-256-GCM encrypted before any S3 upload — set [code]BACKUP_ENCRYPT_KEY[/code] to a 32-byte hex value (generate with [code]openssl rand -hex 32[/code]).
[b]Documentation[/b]: https://tomtom215.github.io/github-backup-rust/
Container.Description:
github-backup is a CLI tool that backs up every kind of data GitHub keeps on a user or organisation — repositories (mirror / bare / shallow), issues, pull requests, releases, gists, wikis, topics, branches, deploy keys, collaborators, workflows, environments, discussions, projects, packages, and account relationships.
This container is a one-shot tool: it runs to completion and exits. To schedule recurring backups, install the User Scripts plugin from Community Applications, add a script that runs `docker start github-backup`, and set a cron entry (e.g. `0 2 * * *` for 2 am daily).
See the upstream project README and docs for the complete flag reference.
Container.Changes: ### 2026.05.12 - Initial Unraid Community Applications template (matches binary v0.3.2). - Bridge networking, /backup volume, masked GITHUB_TOKEN field. - Exposes run mode as a dropdown (`--all`, `--doctor`, `--verify`, …). - Advanced-view fields for GitHub Enterprise Server (`GITHUB_API_URL`, `GITHUB_CLONE_HOST`), OAuth device flow (`GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID`), at-rest encryption (`BACKUP_ENCRYPT_KEY`), and webhook notification (`BACKUP_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK`). - Uses tini as PID 1 for clean SIGTERM handling on `docker stop`.
Container.Requires: An Unraid share to write backups to (default: `/mnt/user/backups/github/`).

Config.Name: Output Directory
Config.Description: Where GitHub backup data is written. Point this at an Unraid share with enough space — a complete backup of an active org can be tens of GiB.

Config.Name: GitHub Owner
Config.Description: The GitHub username or organisation to back up — the first positional argument the tool needs. Example: octocat

Config.Name: GitHub Token
Config.Description: Personal access token used to authenticate to the GitHub API. Classic PAT (`ghp_…`) or fine-grained PAT (`github_pat_…`). For a complete backup including private data, the token needs the `repo` and `read:org` scopes. Run with mode `--list-scopes` to see exactly what the current flag set requires. Generate at: https://github.com/settings/tokens/new

Config.Name: Run Mode
Config.Description: What this container does on each run. `--all` = back up everything (the normal scheduled mode). `--doctor` = pre-flight self-test (no API write). `--check` = validate config + connectivity. `--list-scopes` = print needed OAuth scopes. `--verify` = verify the SHA-256 manifest of an existing backup. `--tui` = interactive UI (run via the Console button).

Config.Name: Extra CLI Flags
Config.Description: Free-form flags appended after the Run Mode. Examples: `--org` (treat owner as an organisation), `--concurrency 8`, `--include-repos 'rust-*'`, `--since 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z`, `--manifest`. See the project documentation for the full reference. Shell metacharacters are rejected up-front to prevent injection from copy-paste mistakes.

Config.Name: GitHub API URL (GHES only)
Config.Description: Override the API base URL for GitHub Enterprise Server. Leave empty for github.com. Example: https://github.example.com/api/v3

Config.Name: GitHub Clone Host (split GHES)
Config.Description: Override the git clone hostname when GHES has split API / clone endpoints behind separate load balancers.

Config.Name: OAuth App Client ID
Config.Description: GitHub OAuth App client ID used by `--device-auth` (pass `--device-auth` in Extra CLI Flags). Create the app at https://github.com/settings/developers — the device flow requires no callback URL.

Config.Name: At-Rest Encryption Key
Config.Description: 32-byte hex-encoded AES-256-GCM key used for encryption before S3 upload. Leave empty if you do not use S3 sync, or generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Lose this key and you lose the ability to decrypt your backups.

Config.Name: Notification Webhook
Config.Description: HTTPS URL receiving a JSON POST with the backup outcome (`success` / `failure`). Notification failures never affect the backup's exit code.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: `tracing` filter for log verbosity. `info` is the default; raise to `debug` while diagnosing a problem.

Config.Name: HTTPS Proxy
Config.Description: Route all GitHub API and git clone traffic through this proxy. Example: http://proxy.example.com:3128 (or http://user:pass@proxy:3128). Honoured by both the Rust HTTP client and git.
